# Test fixtures

Trimmed excerpts of public responses and product pages, recorded once and used by the offline parser tests.
Only the structure each adapter reads is kept (search results reduced to a few items and fields; product pages reduced
to the elements holding the label, ingredients and barcode). Credentials found in page data are replaced with
placeholders.
